distractors_included: The lecture used a broken single-node espresso machine as an analogy for a system with no replicas or failover.
The coffee cart was jokingly described as a Byzantine failure because it claims to be coffee but is not coffee.
The Twelve Angry Men jury illustrates an n-out-of-n quorum: unanimity is safe but loses liveness if one juror is unavailable.
evaluation.rationale: The notes capture a vast amount of technical detail but suffer from catastrophic structural and conciseness failures. The same facts are repeated endlessly across 15 overlapping sections (e.g., 'Core concepts', 'Definitions', 'Examples', 'Formulas / steps', 'Things to memorize', 'Confusing points', 'Questions to review', 'Study summary'). This makes the document nearly unreadable. Furthermore, there is a critical contradiction regarding the Homework 4 deadline, which is correctly stated as Monday in the overview but incorrectly listed as the superseded Friday deadline in the action items. The notes also hallucinate numerous 'open questions' that were explicitly answered during the lecture.
